g.title: ID: task_source Responsibility: Provide task intent and acceptance context. Owner: Operator or task system Runtime: Issue, ticket, chat, or manual request State variables: task_ref; acceptance_contract Invariants: Task intent is retained. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/capture-tabellio-context.mjs:1#context capture @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: agent_runtime Responsibility: Produce model decisions, tool calls, edits, and bounded outputs. Owner: Agent runtime operator Runtime: Codex or compatible agent State variables: run_id; trace_id; tool_call_id Invariants: Runtime events carry source identity and run identity. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents/integrations-observability @ current-2026-08-30

ID: git_source Responsibility: Remain the authority for commits, refs, diffs, and ancestry. Owner: Repository operator Runtime: Git State variables: commit_sha; ref; merge_base Invariants: Commit IDs are immutable. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/capture-tabellio-context.mjs:1#context capture @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: entire_source Responsibility: Remain the authority for checkpoint and session context. Owner: Entire Runtime: Entire CLI State variables: checkpoint_id; session_id; checkpoint_digest Invariants: Checkpoint identity is retained without copying transcript bytes into the ledger. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/providers/entire-ledger-provider.mjs:1#EntireLedgerProvider @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: github_source Responsibility: Provide hosted code, pull requests, reviews, comments, and checks. Owner: GitHub Runtime: Hosted Git service State variables: pr_number; head_sha; checks; reviews Invariants: Review facts identify the exact repository and head. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/providers/github-provider.mjs:1#GitHubProvider @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: ci_source Responsibility: Provide build and check outcomes. Owner: CI operator Runtime: Hosted or operator-managed CI State variables: build_id; commit_sha; status Invariants: Check result identifies the assessed revision. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/validation-runner.md:1#scheduler-agnostic worker @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: source_adapters Responsibility: Translate provider records into bounded canonical events. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: source_event_id; adapter_version; idempotency_key Invariants: Provider-specific differences do not change canonical identity fields. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: event_bus Responsibility: Buffer canonical events and provide retry/backpressure behavior. Owner: Platform operator Runtime: Managed queue or durable local queue State variables: event_id; delivery_count; dead_letter_state Invariants: Delivery is at-least-once and consumers are idempotent. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: ingest_worker Responsibility: Accept events, enforce idempotency, and coordinate canonical persistence. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: event_id; ingest_status; payload_digest Invariants: A retry does not create duplicate evidence. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: canonicalizer Responsibility: Redact secrets, classify sensitivity, canonicalize payloads, and compute digests. Owner: Security and Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: redaction_status; sensitivity; payload_sha256 Invariants: Secrets are blocked before durable persistence. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: provenance_ledger Responsibility: Store typed facts, JSONB payloads, stable identities, and critical relationships. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL State variables: run_id; event_id; repository_id; commit_sha; checkpoint_id Invariants: Critical references satisfy relational constraints.; Facts are append-only or dispositioned. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/ddl-constraints.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/queries-with.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation

ID: artifact_store Responsibility: Store large logs, diffs, traces, and transcripts behind access control. Owner: Platform operator Runtime: Content-addressed object storage State variables: artifact_sha256; uri; sensitivity; retention_class Invariants: Digest and access policy remain attached to every artifact. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: projection_worker Responsibility: Build lineage, stack, review, freshness, and query projections from immutable facts. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Node.js worker State variables: projection_revision; source_event_id; lag Invariants: Projections can be rebuilt from the ledger. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/queries-with.html @ PostgreSQL 18 current documentation

ID: read_model Responsibility: Serve current lineage, stack, review, and exact-head freshness queries. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL read projection State variables: head_sha; review_status; projection_revision Invariants: A projection never authorizes a head different from its assessed head. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: validation_worker Responsibility: Run deterministic product, schema, policy, operational, and security checks. Owner: Operator-managed worker Runtime: Node.js and repository tools State variables: validation_id; commit_sha; manifest_digest; decision Invariants: Validation is bound to an exact revision and manifest. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-validator.mjs:1#validation command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/validation-runner.md:1#scheduler-agnostic worker @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: security_gate Responsibility: Run security-specific checks and emit bounded security evidence. Owner: Security reviewer and Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Trusted validation worker State variables: security_run_id; commit_sha; policy_decision Invariants: Agent claims never substitute for deterministic security evidence. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/operations-hardening.md:1#worker and control-ref hardening @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: context_broker Responsibility: Return bounded project-specific evidence and lessons to a review or agent run. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: Read-only Node.js API or MCP tool State variables: request_scope; head_sha; packet_digest; access_decision Invariants: Context is scoped to the requester, project, repository, and exact head. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/architecture-diagrams.md:1#Tabellio System Architecture Diagrams @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

ID: codex_review Responsibility: Interpret bounded evidence, identify risks, and propose review findings. Owner: Review operator Runtime: Codex or compatible agent State variables: review_id; head_sha; finding_ids Invariants: Codex review does not replace deterministic gates or human approval. Evidence: implemented/source_code: scripts/tabellio-review.mjs:1#review command @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agents/integrations-observability @ current-2026-08-30

ID: evaluation_worker Responsibility: Replay cases, compare behavior, and create scoped candidate lessons. Owner: Tabellio maintainers and evaluation owner Runtime: Node.js worker and evaluation harness State variables: case_id; baseline_version; candidate_version; outcome Invariants: Lessons require evidence references and versioned outcomes. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agent-evals @ current-2026-08-30

ID: lesson_store Responsibility: Store versioned project, organization, and general lessons with evidence links. Owner: Tabellio maintainers Runtime: PostgreSQL projection State variables: lesson_id; scope; status; version; evidence_refs Invariants: Candidate lessons do not silently change global behavior. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca; intended/external_document: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/agent-evals @ current-2026-08-30

ID: human_approver Responsibility: Own accepted risk, privacy decisions, and promotion approval. Owner: Assigned human owner Runtime: Review interface State variables: decision; approver; decision_time Invariants: The system never fabricates human approval. Evidence: intended/design_document: docs/agent-provenance-ledger-and-codex-feedback.md:1#Agent Provenance Ledger and Codex Feedback Plan @ 979a81d07994f8024c3b071581165de94685d2ca

text.tspan: Agent trace event / trace export or bounded event API
Commit and ref event / Git hook, polling adapter, or webhook
Checkpoint event / Entire CLI JSON or checkpoint export
PR and review event / GitHub webhook or bounded API poll
Build and check event / CI webhook or artifact export
Normalize incoming event / internal JSON API
Persist fact and relationships / PostgreSQL transaction
Store large content by digest / content-addressed object API
Validation result event / canonical event API
Security result event / canonical event API
Read current lineage and review state / read-only query API
Resolve exact facts and digests / read-only PostgreSQL query
Read scoped lessons / read-only query API
Provide bounded review context / MCP or read-only API
Review findings and outcome / validated review event API
Select replay cases and outcomes / read-only query API
Store candidate or approved lesson / PostgreSQL transaction
Request promotion decision / review UI or approval API
